svg.title: Tron disc outer face — 260 mm OD, 120 mm ID
svg.desc: Actual size in millimetres. White diffuser: OD 260, ID 120. Black mask: OD 252, ID 120; C aperture radii 69 and 73, 4 mm wide, 340 degree arc with one 20 degree gap centered at 12 o'clock. Outer white border 4 mm radially. Center hole transparent. No fastener holes included.
